g.text: Engineering review draft — not released for manufacture

g.desc: Engineering review draft — not released for manufacture

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: GYBMEP module in the vented gas chamber. Four-wire harness, maximum 30 cm; dedicated sensor I2C at 100 kHz.

g.desc: GYBMEP module in the vented gas chamber. Four-wire harness, maximum 30 cm; dedicated sensor I2C at 100 kHz.

g.text: Wire to the module labels, not its board colour.

g.desc: Wire to the module labels, not its board colour.

g.text: VIN / GND / SCL / SDA, as photographed.

g.desc: VIN / GND / SCL / SDA, as photographed.

g.text: Use strain relief at both cable ends.

g.desc: Use strain relief at both cable ends.

g.text: 1. Read chip ID register 0xD0: BME280 must return 0x60.

g.desc: 1. Read chip ID register 0xD0: BME280 must return 0x60.

g.text: BMP280 does not measure humidity. Probe 0x76 and 0x77.

g.desc: BMP280 does not measure humidity. Probe 0x76 and 0x77.

g.text: 2. Verify the actual module VDD / VDDIO and pull-up rail.

g.desc: 2. Verify the actual module VDD / VDDIO and pull-up rail.

g.text: Chip limits: VDD 1.71-3.6 V; VDDIO 1.2-3.6 V.

g.desc: Chip limits: VDD 1.71-3.6 V; VDDIO 1.2-3.6 V.

g.text: The product photograph does not prove the fitted regulator.

g.desc: The product photograph does not prove the fitted regulator.

g.text: 3. R603/R604 are unpopulated initially; use module pull-ups.

g.desc: 3. R603/R604 are unpopulated initially; use module pull-ups.

g.text: Fit only after checking their rail and the installed resistance.

g.desc: Fit only after checking their rail and the installed resistance.

g.text: Host pull-ups are on the host interface sheet.

g.desc: Host pull-ups are on the host interface sheet.

g.text: 4. Measure rise time with the complete cable: <=1 us at 100 kHz.

g.desc: 4. Measure rise time with the complete cable: <=1 us at 100 kHz.

g.text: Keep total bus capacitance within the device / I2C limits.

g.desc: Keep total bus capacitance within the device / I2C limits.

g.text: BSS138 translates logic; it does not isolate a stuck-low bus.

g.desc: BSS138 translates logic; it does not isolate a stuck-low bus.

g.text: U601 is off-board; only J601 is mounted on the main PCB.

g.desc: U601 is off-board; only J601 is mounted on the main PCB.

g.text: Keep the sensor away from the MD62 heater and regulator.

g.desc: Keep the sensor away from the MD62 heater and regulator.

g.text: Use a regulated, vented chamber near atmospheric pressure.

g.desc: Use a regulated, vented chamber near atmospheric pressure.

g.text: Allow gas contact with the sensor opening; prevent condensation.

g.desc: Allow gas contact with the sensor opening; prevent condensation.

g.text: This chamber sensor does not replace the battery thermistor.

g.desc: This chamber sensor does not replace the battery thermistor.

g.text: Fit only R601 initially. Never fit both links.

g.desc: Fit only R601 initially. Never fit both links.

g.text: R602 requires a verified 5 V VIN module.

g.desc: R602 requires a verified 5 V VIN module.

g.text: Check the module regulator output and pull-ups

g.desc: Check the module regulator output and pull-ups
